cca-prep: a dedicated fleet repo accompanying the operator through all Claude certification levels (Architect-Foundations in flight, Developer-Foundations, Architect-Professional). Core capabilities: (1) repeatable question-generation pipeline as a skill — fresh-context hard-mode deck authoring from official exam guides, blind-solve QA validation, item-analysis-driven retirement of stale/easy questions, keep-it-fresh regeneration since the operator memorizes decks fast (just went 30/30 on a mock via recognition); (2) research/scraping layer for synthetic-question best practices from official docs and reputable methodology sources (hard constraint: never braindump/exam-dump sources — NDA and program policy); (3) adaptive learning loop reading the existing progress telemetry (SQLite + ~/selfco/teach/cca-foundations-prep/progress/progress.json + study-notes.md) to bias generation toward weak task statements; (4) operator-elevation feedback: [project]-tagged study notes triaged into ojfbot architecture improvements (beads/issues), and knowledge written back to the selfco vault — honoring the ojfbot core thesis that the fleet is a teaching/operator-elevating device. Existing assets to absorb or interface with: the zero-dependency drill app (node:http+node:sqlite, port 8630) currently living in ~/selfco/teach/cca-foundations-prep/app/ with an 81-question v1 bank and an independent hard-mode deck being authored right now by a background agent; the audited gap-analysis method; the .handoff brief for Developer/Professional research (20260811-1810). Open decisions to grill: repo scaffold source (scaffold-app template vs bespoke), what migrates from the vault teach corpus into the repo vs stays (progress state surface), skill naming/packaging in core's catalog, and how the adaptive loop is triggered (on-demand skill vs cron/routine).
